plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: 送出前，依 session 的模型與 effort，對照 Anthropic 的提示詞指引評審每一則 prompt。教練模式顯示結果讓你選，自動模式直接套用。介面為正體中文；英文版是 prompt-coach-en。

mode.title: 模式
mode.description: coach：顯示評審結果，由我決定怎麼送出。auto：不詢問，直接套用。off：不處理。預設：coach

auto_style.title: 自動模式的做法
auto_style.description: append：保留我打的原文，附加只有 Claude 讀得到的補充。rewrite：把 prompt 換成改寫後的版本。預設：append

pass_score.title: 通過分數
pass_score.description: 教練模式下，分數達到這個值（0–100）就直接送出，不詢問。預設：85

auto_send_seconds.title: 沒回應時自動送出（秒）
auto_send_seconds.description: 教練模式的卡片等這麼多秒沒有回應，就用原文送出，卡片上會倒數。設 0 表示不自動送出（等 10 分鐘後取消）。只適用於窗格與輸入框上方的資訊帶；Claude Code 的詢問對話框會一直等你回答。預設：60

backend.title: 評審後端
backend.description: session：透過 Claude Code 自己的連線評審（你的訂閱方案、API key 或雲端供應商）。api_key：用下方的金鑰呼叫 Messages API 評審。預設：session

engine.title: session 的評審方式
engine.description: fork：由 session 的模型帶著完整對話評審，沿用 prompt cache。complete：另外呼叫一次，只看得到對話摘要。預設：fork

fork_effort.title: fork 評審的 effort
fork_effort.description: low：評審指定低 effort，最快。session：不指定，照 session 的 effort 執行；你的模型或供應商只能對整個請求設定 effort 時選這個，否則每次評審會把對話重寫一份 prompt cache。預設：low

review_model.title: 評審模型
review_model.description: complete 與 api_key 後端用的模型：session（session 正在用的模型）、haiku、sonnet、opus、fable，或完整模型 ID。預設：session

api_key.title: Anthropic API 金鑰
api_key.description: 只有 api_key 後端會用。也可以改設環境變數 PROMPT_COACH_API_KEY。預設：不設定

api_base_url.title: API 網址
api_base_url.description: api_key 後端送出請求的網址。預設：https://api.anthropic.com

timeout_seconds.title: 評審逾時（秒）
timeout_seconds.description: 評審超過這個秒數，就照原文送出。預設：25

min_chars.title: 最短評審長度
min_chars.description: 比這個字元數短的 prompt 不呼叫模型評審，即時掃描照常執行。預設：8

fork_max_tokens.title: fork 的對話上限
fork_max_tokens.description: 對話超過這個 context tokens 數時改用 complete，評審成本就不會跟著對話成長。預設：200000

headless.title: 評審 claude -p 與 SDK 的 prompt
headless.description: 關閉時只評審在輸入框打的 prompt。教練模式不會攔住無頭模式的 prompt。預設：關閉

plugins.name: prompt-coach-en
plugins.description: Reviews each prompt before it is sent, against Anthropic's prompting guidance for the session's model and effort level. Coach mode shows the findings and lets you choose; auto mode applies them. English interface; the Traditional Chinese build is prompt-coach.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coach: show the review and let me choose. auto: apply it without asking. off: do nothing. Default: coach

auto_style.title: Auto mode style
auto_style.description: append: leave my words as typed and attach notes only Claude reads. rewrite: replace my prompt with the improved version. Default: append

pass_score.title: Pass score
pass_score.description: Coach mode sends a prompt without asking when it scores at least this much (0-100). Default: 85

auto_send_seconds.title: Auto-send after (seconds)
auto_send_seconds.description: When a coach card gets no answer for this many seconds, the prompt is sent as typed; the card counts down. 0 turns this off (the card is cancelled after 10 minutes). Applies to the pane and the band above the prompt; Claude Code's question dialog waits for your answer. Default: 60

backend.title: Review backend
backend.description: session: review through Claude Code's own connection (your plan, API key or cloud provider). api_key: review through the Messages API with the key below. Default: session

engine.title: Session review engine
engine.description: fork: the session's own model reviews with the whole conversation in view, reusing its prompt cache. complete: a separate call that sees only a digest of the conversation. Default: fork

fork_effort.title: Effort of a fork review
fork_effort.description: low: the review asks for low effort, the quickest. session: it names no level and runs at the session's; choose this when your model or provider takes effort for a whole request only, where a different level writes the conversation to the prompt cache again. Default: low

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model for the complete engine and the api_key backend: session (the model the session runs), haiku, sonnet, opus, fable, or a full model id. Default: session

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Used only by the api_key backend. The PROMPT_COACH_API_KEY environment variable works too. Default: none

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Where the api_key backend sends requests. Default: https://api.anthropic.com

timeout_seconds.title: Review timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: When a review takes longer than this, the prompt is sent as typed. Default: 25

min_chars.title: Shortest prompt to review
min_chars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters skip the model review. The instant pattern check still runs. Default: 8

fork_max_tokens.title: Largest conversation to fork
fork_max_tokens.description: Past this many context tokens the review uses the complete engine, so its cost stops growing with the conversation. Default: 200000

headless.title: Review prompts from claude -p and the SDK
headless.description: When off, only prompts typed at the prompt box are reviewed. Coach mode never holds a headless prompt. Default: off

metadata.description: Prompt Coach: a Claude Code mod that reviews each prompt before it is sent. prompt-coach is the Traditional Chinese build, prompt-coach-en the English one; install one of them.
